name: web-search
description: Search the web through the Tavily search API.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web and return result titles, URLs, and snippets. It calls a search API with the agent's own key, so there is nothing to sign in to; a search when no key is configured fails saying so, and is the operator's to fix. Follow a result with web_fetch, or web_browse if the page needs its scripts to run.

tavily_api_key.title: Tavily API key
tavily_api_key.description: The key searches are made with. Without it every search fails saying so.

tavily_url.title: Search API address
tavily_url.description: Leave empty to use Tavily's own.
